title: Category of strategic games and presheaf corresponding to solution concepts or welfare criteria
abstract: arXiv:2608.08310v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We define a category of strategic games in which a morphism is a pair of a map between sets of players and a map between sets of strategy profiles with specific properties and show that this category is well-defined. Three cases are considered for the maps between sets of strategy profiles: they may be order-preserving, order-reflecting or order-embedding with respect to each player's preference relation. We define a presheaf on the category of games valued in a category of sets that sends each strategic game to a set of strategy profiles and present conditions for this presheaf to be well-defined. Two cases are considered for the morphisms in the category of sets: they may be relations or maps. We define a presheaf that sends each strategic game to the set of Nash equilibria (resp. translated_title: 战略博弈的范畴与对应解概念或福利准则的预层
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.08310v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：我们定义了一个战略博弈的范畴，其中态射是由玩家集合之间的映射和策略剖面集合之间具有特定性质的映射组成的对，并证明该范畴是良定义的。对于策略剖面集合之间的映射，我们考虑了三种情况：它们可能关于每个玩家的偏好关系是保序的、反序的或嵌入序的。我们定义了一个在博弈范畴上取值于集合范畴的预层，该预层将每个战略博弈映射到策略剖面集合，并给出了该预层良定义的条件。对于集合范畴中的态射，我们考虑了两种情况：它们可以是关系或映射。我们定义了一个将每个战略博弈映射到纳什均衡集合（分别地，帕累托有效策略剖面集合）的预层，并证明当且仅当策略剖面集合之间的映射是反序的时，该预层才是良定义的。
tldr: 本文定义了战略博弈的范畴，并构造了将博弈映射到纳什均衡或帕累托有效策略的预层，揭示了其良定义性依赖于策略映射的反序性条件。
en_tdlr: This paper defines a category of strategic games and constructs presheaves mapping games to Nash equilibria or Pareto efficient profiles, showing their well-definedness relies on order-reflecting strategy maps.
